A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are working on a semantic indexing system for text documents which is based on a semantic network.
we are working on a new way of indexing text documents in a way that is not based on the actual textual content of the document but on the actual meaning of the document.
we are able to generate a semantic network of documents which is based on the content of the documents, and which can be used for semantic search.

semantic indexing of text data is a feasible approach to improve the quality of information search.
the semantic annotation of text documents is feasible and the resulting semantic network is of high quality.
